metadata.description: 汎用知識スフィア — 実験・開発用
metadata._mode_note: core = full metabolism. sanctuary = read-only, no metabolism (frozen sphere for standalone deployment)

perception._comment: 知覚の物理法則: M = T / (a × D)

field._comment: Global Ambient Field - スフィア全体の気候 (2分周期で更新)

evaluation._comment: 2-Layer evaluation coefficients: agent input (0-10) → delta = (input - neutral) × coefficient
evaluation._maturity_comment: maturityPreWeight: multiplier on coefficients based on sphere lifecycle phase. Applied as coef × preWeight.

young._comment: weight 蓄積を促進 — 初期成長を助ける

elder._comment: 安定性重視 — 変動を抑制、揮発性判定を強化

evaluation._maturity_note: maturityStage is determined by sanctification epoch count: 0=young, 1-2=mature, 3+=elder

packer._comment: Integer scale: h/w threshold 1000, d baseline 1000

session._comment: Gateway session timeout for Dive connections (phi-agent needs longer TTL for CPU inference)

ascension._comment: Ascension cooldown: evaluation freeze + h+w score + lower threshold
ascension._comment_cooldown: 5min (300000ms) for testing. Production: 10min (600000). Heat decays faster than weight, so cooldown acts as a heat-purge filter — burst-evaluated nodes drop out, weight-stable nodes survive.
ascension._comment_allostatic: effectiveThreshold = scoreThreshold × clamp(sqrt(activeNodes / referenceNodeCount), floor, cap). floor=0.6 → min threshold 660.
ascension._comment_lowerThreshold: 0.9 = must maintain 90% of initial score during cooldown. Dropout: h=relic(300), w=normal(100) — weight penalty for failed candidacy.
ascension._comment_immune: Immune Threshold Amplification: effectiveRatio = min(cap, baseRatio + weight × max(0, immuneMod - 1.0)). immuneMod 1.018+ → cap hit → dropout under archive×0.5. Derived: weight = (avgRetention - baseRatio) / criticalDev ≈ 5.0

dropoutReset._comment: Metrics reset on cooldown failure — h=relic tier (findable), w=normal tier (weight stripped as punishment)

absorption._comment: Crystallization on successful ascension - absorb nearby nodes

erosion._comment: Erosion cooldown: amber → active delayed by cooldown period. No eval freeze — other agents can save the node.

revival._comment: Fossil → Active revival conditions (h×w product + d stability gate)

decay._comment: preset: archive | natural | flow | dev (未指定時は NODE_ENV から自動判定)
decay._decayIntensity_note: Global multiplier on all decay factors (alpha, heat, weight, flux). 1.0=preset default, 0.5=half decay, 0.33=1/3 decay. Applied on top of preset values.

dormancy._comment: Metabolism hibernation when no agents connected

pulse._comment: UDP broadcast for external observers (Observatory, etc.)

sanctification._comment: Three-party consensus for sphere state sanctification (Hard/Soft/Meta)
sanctification._epochGrowth_note: 0 = Sphere Original (clean). Set >0 for progressive difficulty per epoch.
sanctification._metabolicAutoMode_note: Allostatic: bands relative to Hard baseline. <bl×0.5=flow, <bl=natural, ≥bl=archive. [Testing] false + preset=archive to prevent weight decay from cancelling eval gains in young sphere.

cleanerFish._comment: Autonomous GC - hunger scales both target range AND throughput

ephemeral._comment: Ephemeral mode: periodic state reset (for public demo deployment)

external_services._comment: External services that connect to Sphere via network protocols

observatory.description: Pulse signal monitor and anomaly detector

agent._comment: Internal agent tick settings (step accumulation model)

metricsUpdate._comment: Metrics are updated on node transition, not every tick
